slice: P2 source-bound AC1027 MLEADERSTYLE group-91 ACI leaderColor
scope: One runtime-authored AC1027 DXF source with two root-reachable MLEADERSTYLE records. STANDARD has one existing group-91 INTEGER ACI value 0 and an opaque group-302 tag; SECONDARY is unchanged. Supports a standalone typed leaderColor change from 0 to 7 only when no group 420-449 CMC extension appears in the style body.

fieldEvidence.fieldRoleSource: Autodesk AutoCAD DXF Reference, MLEADERSTYLE group-code table
fieldEvidence.wireTypeSource: Autodesk DXF Group Codes reference, codes 90-99 are 32-bit integers; selected MLEADERSTYLE color value is an ACI INTEGER

contract.admission: Source and target must both be AC1027. The selected record must be reachable through the validated ACAD_MLEADERSTYLE dictionary, have one source-matched raw body and immutable source baseline, and contain one existing group-91 INTEGER corresponding to parsed leaderColor. The edited value must be within the library's validated ACI range 0..256. No group 420-449 may occur in the AcDbMLeaderStyle body. leaderColor must be the only changed typed payload field; table-entry identity, common fields, handles, application data, extension data and every other encoded style field must match the source.
contract.projection: Replace only the existing physical group-91 value in a copy of the captured raw body using the ordinary INTEGER variant. Preserve all other ordered fields and opaque groups. Missing/repeated group 91, conflicting raw changes, simultaneous edits, CMC extension groups 420-449, unknown subclass grammar and non-AC1027 routes remain outside this transaction. The ACI field uses the ordinary INTEGER variant required by the MLEADERSTYLE raw-record validator; truecolor, color-name and transparency forms remain refused.
contract.outputAndReadback: Inspect staged OBJECTS output against retained raw fields and mapped handles, then decode the emitted MLEADERSTYLE and require leaderColor to equal 7 while unchanged maxLeaderPoints remains 0 and leaderLineWeight remains 25. Fresh readback checks the typed values and exactly one literal group-91 INTEGER value 7. Both source encodings are exercised; output uses same-format and cross-format ASCII/binary paths.
contract.failureAndRetry: Changing captured raw group 91 from 0 to 1 while typed leaderColor requests 7 refuses and preserves a sentinel destination. A simultaneous group-90 edit refuses atomically. A late typed color mutation after preflight refuses without replacing the destination; restoring the requested value permits same-adapter retry. An authored source containing group 420 truecolor metadata refuses a group-91 edit and preserves the destination. Exact output and fresh-readback checks pass after retry.
contract.compatibility: Untouched MLEADERSTYLE records keep existing raw replay. Transactions are not admitted for other source or target versions, multiple changes on one record, or extended CMC color forms. Typed DWG-origin writing remains unchanged. Test sources and outputs are authored at runtime in a temporary directory and removed; no drawing fixture is committed.

sourceBindings.fixtureRecipe: generateRootMLeaderStyleControl in tests/dwg2dxf_adapter_tests.cpp emits group 91=0 and group 92=25 in the AcDbMLeaderStyle subclass. Its optional guard source adds group 420=0x123456 after group 91. ASCII and binary inputs are generated locally from scratch.

limitations: Evidence qualifies one authored AC1027 ACI transaction only. It does not prove independent producer variation, native color appearance, truecolor/color-book/transparency rewriting, cross-version support, DWG editing, other MLEADERSTYLE color fields, consumer acceptance or full document closure.
No support claim is promoted; the support ledger remains closed.
